judge.rationale: The candidate implements the basic mechanics of listing sessions over WebSocket off the per-session lock, but diverges sharply from the issue specification on nearly every detail. It names the frames and types `list_sessions` / `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the required `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, instead enabling the feature unconditionally and returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor`—directly violating the explicit requirement and acceptance criterion to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error rather than an empty list. Validation also fails the acceptance criteria by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of restricting `limit` to integers 1–200. Finally, it leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and misses updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
